balls.text: another slower ball into the track outside off. Like the previous ball, this dies after pitching and Rabada has to abandon his shot mid-way. Sai Kishore tries to smuggle a bye but Rickelton hits bulls-eye at the batter's end to ensure GT finish on 196! Hang on...GT have reviewed this for a wide. Pretty sure nothing will come out of this, and that is exactly the case. Well inside the tramlines and GT indeed finish four short of 200!
slower ball into the track outside off and this dies on its way through to the keeper. Beyond the tramlines too, and the umpire has to indulge in some more exercise
full toss on the stumps. Sai Kishore stays leg side and punches it towards mid off. Scampers across to the other end, although he would have been out with a direct hit

Rashid perishes! And Raju has his first IPL wicket! Fullish outside off. Rashid skips down the track and then tries to almost slog-sweep it. Gets into an undesirable position for the stroke and skies it towards long on. Pandya runs in and gobbles up the chance. Pandya embraces Raju, and the youngster has something to show for his toil tonight!
nails the wide yorker to perfection. Seems to sneak just inside the tramlines and Rashid does not get the wide call he is after
right out of the screws! Back of a length outside off and that is just the sort of length Rashid is after. He clears his front leg and mauls it over long on!
length ball hung up wide outside off. Rashid throws the kitchen sink at it but still cannot make contact. Called a wide and MI opt not to review
slower ball on a full length on leg stump. Rabada backs away and swings for the hills. Makes no contact and Rashid is sharp enough to pinch a bye
superb slower yorker outside off. Dips on Rashid late and he cannot squeeze it out into the off side
back of a length outside off. Rabada looks to repeat the dose but the ball sticks in the surface just enough to ensure he chalks it. Single to long off
oh, hello! Chahar bowls it into the slot outside off and Rabada climbs into it. Free swing through the line and the ball goes soaring over the bowler's head!
fullish just outside off. Rabada looks to go downtown first up but only connects with the fresh Ahmedabad air

two in two in the over for the Mumbai Indians, three in three overall, and all of a sudden, this Titans innings is in a tailspin! Back of a length outside off. Rutherford sits deep in his crease and looks to carve it away. Gets under it but not enough to clear the fence. Deep extra cover comes around to his left, settles under the high ball and does the rest. Perfect planning, perfect execution, and MI have momentum!

it is all happening here! Length ball wide outside off. Rutherford powers it straight to mid off. Tewatia takes a start and then has to go back because of how quickly that got to Pandya at mid off. Pandya then hits the stumps at the bowler's end and Tewatia cannot drag his bat behind the crease in time. Oh wow, that is not a great bit of cricket by the batter, but MI will not mind. They will not mind one bit!

massive lbw shout, and Boult sends Sudharsan on his way! This is a searing leg-stump yorker that seems to tail in late as well. Sudharsan cannot get his bat down in time and the ball breezes past the inside edge to smash him on the back leg. Right in front of leg stump and the umpire has no hesitation in raising his finger. Sudharsan does not bother with the review either, and MI get the set batter with two overs still left!
full toss wide outside off. Rutherford does well to reach it but cannot do much with it after that. Scuffed towards mid off
excellent yorker on middle and off. Sudharsan jams down on it and digs it out into the off side
dug into the track on leg stump. Rutherford gets inside the line and swings it away towards deep backward square leg
slower delivery dug into the track just outside off. Rutherford cannot come to grips with the lack of pace and wafts at thin air
and Boult gets smoked over cow corner! Rutherford is cooking, folks! Low full toss speared into middle and leg. Rutherford uses his wrists to get under it and shovels it away!
low full toss hung up wide outside off. Rutherford reaches out for it and pushes it towards long off. 19 off the 17th over!

into the blockhole wide outside off. Sudharsan cannot get under it despite advancing and clinks it towards extra cover. Santner hits the stumps at the batter's end but Rutherford had made it comfortably
low full toss wide outside off. Sudharsan throws his hands at it and drills it to sweeper cover's right. Has enough time to race back for two
Sudharsan goes big too now! This is seam-up but again in the slot outside off. Sudharsan takes a step across, gets down low and clubs it over deep mid wicket!
nails the yorker and the line on this occasion. Outside off and Rutherford can only squeeze it out to short third
another attempted wide yorker, although this is clearly beyond the tramlines. Rutherford cannot reach it and the umpire calls it a wide
fetch that, says Sherfane Rutherford! Slower ball that lands right in the slot outside off. Rutherford reads it like the morning daily and smokes it clean over long off!

goes for the wide yorker but ends up bowling a wide full toss. Rutherford tries to access it but cannot lay bat on ball. Not called a wide, which prompts Rutherford to review. Rutherford's back foot is a little outside off, which means the tramlines move as well. But the ball is further away, so the wide has been given now after review!
shortish just outside leg. Rutherford gets inside the line and helps it towards fine leg
slower bumper again, which is not a big surprise. Rutherford swipes at it and only swats away a few flies in the process. Called a wide, though
goes short again but this is too short. Balloons past the batter and once he lets it go, the square leg umpire has no qualms in calling it a wide
yorker, following the batter outside leg. Sudharsan tucks it off his toes towards deep mid wicket
slower bumper just outside leg. Rutherford gets inside the line and hooks it down to fine leg

the plan works a charm, and Pandya has his man! Slow, short and wide again, although this is much shorter and wider than the ball that went for a six to the other side. Shahrukh has no option but to try and muscle it over deep cover but fails to generate the power he is after. Straight down Tilak's throat, and Pandya has a wry smile on his face!
off-pace on a back of a length outside off. Shahrukh has a wild yahoo across the line and only connects with fresh air
Pandya tries the double-bluff, and gets outwitted by Shahrukh! Banged in short outside off. Shahrukh picks it early, swivels and smears it over square leg!
back of a length on middle and leg. Shahrukh clears his front leg and hoicks it towards deep backward square leg
very full on middle and leg. Sudharsan has a swish at it and squirts it off the inside edge towards short fine leg
slower ball dug into the track on off stump. Shahrukh waits for it and heaves it towards deep backward square leg

into the blockhole just outside off. Sudharsan jams it off the inside edge into his pads. The ball then rolls away to the right, and Shahrukh smuggles a single, with Boult unable to swoop in cleanly on his follow-through
off-pace again on a length just outside off. Shahrukh stands tall and slaps it towards extra cover, whose misfield allows Sudharsan to get across for a single
back of a length outside off. Sudharsan waits for it and chops it behind point. Brings up his fifty off 33 balls too, and raises his bat to take in the applause!
zipped in full on the stumps. Shahrukh pats it back to the bowler, who fields it smartly
oh dear - that is the worst ball to bowl at this stage! Darted in a mile outside leg. Shahrukh does not get bat on it and Rickelton cannot get around to it either. Five bonus runs!

nicked and gone! Mujeeb gets the big fish, and that is a massive moment in the game! Carrom ball hung up on a length wide outside off. Buttler tries to smash it into next week but loses his shape just a touch. Gets a healthy edge and Rickelton gobbles up the chance with consummate ease. Buttler walks back disappointed; MI, meanwhile, elated!
fullish outside off. Sudharsan laces his cover drive and extra cover misfields to allow a single. Rohit was the fielder on that occasion
low full toss outside off. Buttler reaches out for it and clinks it towards long off
shot! Marginally short and Buttler latches onto it. Sits deep in his crease and pummels it between long on and deep mid wicket!
full and wide outside off. Buttler throws his hands at it and drills it past extra cover. Good work on the fence by Tilak to prevent the boundary
clever, clever batting! Slower bumper, angling into middle and off. Sudharsan watches it and arches his back at the last moment to glide it over the keeper's head!
another slower ball, on a length outside off. Buttler drags it towards long on
off-pace on a length on off. Sudharsan does not pick it until very late and bunts it to the left of the pitch for a single
on a length on off. Buttler gets onto the front foot and drives it on the up to long off

oh dear - what kind of ball was that?! Slower bumper that is so short that Raju nearly took out his own toe-nail with it. Buttler has to wait and wait and wait and when the ball does arrive, he smacks it between deep mid wicket and deep backward square leg!
slower ball on a length just outside off. Sudharsan hacks it down the ground to long on
shortish on off. Sudharsan gives himself a bit of room and cuts it towards sweeper cover
length on middle and leg. Sudharsan nurdles it into the vast open mid wicket region and tears back for the second. Brilliant running!
tossed up full outside off. Buttler connects with his reverse-sweep this time and helps it towards short third
oh dear - more sloppy work in the field! Fullish outside off. Buttler plants his front foot and drills it towards long off. Dhir lets it slip through his fingers, and the ball hits the fence!
shorter outside off. Buttler shapes for the cut but the lack of pace means he scuffs it towards extra cover
floated up full and wide, perhaps after pre-empting the reverse. Buttler tries to manufacture something but only grabs a handful of fresh air
slower delivery dug into the track outside off. Buttler stands up tall and hacks it towards deep mid wicket

cutter on a length just outside off. Buttler stabs it to the edge of the circle in the mid on region. Both batters decide on the second and Sudharsan has to sprawl to complete it. A direct hit by Tilak might have made things interesting
Buttler is on the charge! Banged into the track outside off and this time, Buttler is ready for it. He hops up onto his toes and hammers it over mid wicket!
off-pace on a shortish length, following the batter outside leg. Sudharsan eases it out to deep square leg
back of a length on middle and leg. Buttler gets inside the line and glances it down to fine leg

Rickelton and Pandya appeal for a caught-behind, and they go upstairs! Slower bumper just outside off. Cuts back in a little and Buttler is too early into the pull. The ball seems to pass through without scraping the bat, although replays might provide further conclusive evidence of that. There seems to be a clear gap between bat and ball, and UltraEdge confirms it. MI burn a review, and Buttler stays!
shortish on the stumps. Buttler gets onto the back foot and knocks it to long off
innovation at its best! Fired in quicker on a back of a length just outside off. Buttler shuffles across and laps it neatly past the keeper!

goes a mile up, and just clears the fence! Given plenty of air on a full length on middle stump. Buttler gets under it a fair bit and the ball touches the moon before it comes down. Raju, stood on the fence, tries to take it while over-looking the boundary and gets hands to it. Fails to hold on, though!
angled in on a fullish length on leg stump. Sudharsan comes forward and tucks it off his pads towards deep square leg
back of a length on leg stump. Buttler helps it round the corner

big lbw shout, not given! Angled in on a back of a length on off. Buttler gets into position for the paddle-sweep early but then misses it. Gets rapped on the front thigh and Santner is very interested. The umpire is not, though, and MI do not go upstairs
back of a length on middle and leg. Buttler pats it enough to mid wicket's right and gets off the mark with a single
length just outside off. Buttler has a loose prod at it and chunks it off the inside half of the bat towards mid wicket
off-pace on a length outside off. Buttler looks to drive on the up but the ball squirms under the toe-end of his bat. That kept quite low

straight to deep backward square leg! The former GT captain gets the current GT skipper, and Pandya's grip over Gill in this particular match-up grows stronger! 4 dismissals in 18 balls now. This is another short ball, sitting up on middle and off. Gill gets a massive piece of this and absolutely laces it. The problem, however, is that he also picks out the fielder in the deep. Dhir makes no mistake and Gill cannot believe what he has done. Pandya just stands there with a beaming smile, and this is just the breakthrough MI would have been after!
slower ball on a length outside off. Gill comes forward and tugs it to the edge of the ring in the mid on region. Gill calls for two early and Sudharsan has to hustle to make it back
banged into the track outside off. A bit of tennis-ball bounce and Sudharsan cannot get over it completely. Shanks it towards deep mid wicket
shortish, pitching just outside off and spinning back in. Sudharsan hops back and punches it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length outside off. Sudharsan goes back and pokes it towards extra cover
back of a length just outside off. Gill hangs back and cuts it towards backward point, who dives to his right and ensures it is just a single. Raju the fielder
length outside off. Sudharsan brings out the reverse and scuffs it behind point for a single
fired in fuller just outside off. Driven out to the sweeper on the deep cover fence
length just outside off. Gill presses half forward and taps it towards extra cover
fullish just outside off. Gill gets a good stride in and drives it crisply to long off
off-pace on a back of a length outside off. Gill takes a step down the track but has to check his shot because of the lack of pace. Tugs it back to the bowler, who fields it athletically to his right
dug into the track outside off. Gill lets it go but the square leg umpire, this time, is happy with the height. Called second bouncer for the over
fuller outside off. Sudharsan gets forward and drives it towards sweeper cover
another slower one, on a length just outside off. Gill drops it into the off side and canters across to the other end
off-pace on a back of a length just outside off. Sudharsan waits for it and turns it into the mid wicket region
banged in short first up, just outside leg. Sudharsan ducks under it and the umpire calls it a wide. A wide for height
that has been absolutely smashed! Slower ball that ends up being a half-tracker outside off. Gill reads it early and swats it powerfully past mid wicket!
slower bumper that goes awry and loops well over the batter's head. Easy decision for the square leg umpire

banged into the track on middle and leg, and this seems to rush onto the batter. Sudharsan tugs it towards deep square leg, and then MI shoot themselves in the foot with an errant throw to the bowler's end, which is backed up by a grand total of zero people. Dhir was the guilty party with the throw, although he might have sensed a run-out opportunity, given Sudharsan was walking across for the single. Neither Pandya (at mid off), or Rohit (at extra cover) backed up either. Terrible cricket, says Sunil Gavaskar on air!
length on middle stump. Gill turns it towards mid wicket and hares across to the other end
regal stroke-making! Length on middle and off, and Gill converts it into a slot ball by advancing. Clean swing through the line and he bangs it over Chahar's head!
leg-cutter on a back of a length just outside off. Gill shapes for the short-arm pull but scuffs it a little. Pandya tracks it down to his right from mid on and keeps it to two
off-pace and into the track just outside off. Sudharsan gets up on his toes and stabs it towards mid off
darted in short and into the pads again. Gill tries to access the region behind square on the leg side but only picks out square leg. He will feel he missed out there
Gill wants a piece of the fun too! This is a proper buffet ball, to be completely honest. Well down leg and Gill just helps it over short fine leg!
slower and fuller outside off. Sudharsan stretches forward and drives it towards mid off, where Pandya dives to his right and saves three
on the shorter side again, just outside off. Sudharsan hops back and jabs it towards extra cover
follows up the four with a six! Floatier and fuller outside off. Sudharsan plants his front foot, goes through the line and pumps it over the bowler's head!
and he gets welcomed with a boundary! A bit of a drag-down outside off. Sits up nicely for Sudharsan and he has all the time in the world to crash it through cover!
slanted into the stumps. Sudharsan comes forward and flicks it to mid on. Calls for the single and a misfield by Santner makes that a very comfortable exercise
another bumper but this seems to balloon over the batter's head. Sudharsan ducks under it and the umpire says it is high enough to be called a wide
back of a length just outside off. Holds a little in the surface and seems to bounce extra as Gill plonks it towards sweeper cover
length on off. Gill takes a step down the track and drives it on the up to extra cover
short outside off. Seems like another change-up and Sudharsan hangs back, cutting it towards deep point
banged into the track outside off. Sudharsan has a look at it and is then happy to let it go. Called one bouncer for the over
leg-cutter on a back of a length just outside off. Gill waits for it and dabs it through the backward point region for a single
back of a length outside off. Skids on and keeps a touch low, with Gill eventually running it down to short third
shortish on leg stump. Sudharsan gets up on his toes and tucks it off his hips towards deep square leg
another gorgeous stroke! Slower ball that lands right in the slot on middle and leg. Sudharsan uses the angle, waits for the slower ball and then clips it delightfully past mid wicket!
pushed in on a length on middle and off. Sudharsan transfers his weight forward and nudges it past mid wicket for a brace

oh my word - that is a shot and a half! Back of a length just outside off. Shapes away a little but it does not matter to Sudharsan, who dances down the track, stands up tall and creams an on-drive past Boult!
fullish outside off. Sudharsan presses forward and punches it towards extra cover
full outside off. Gill goes fishing at it away from his body and chunks it off the inside edge into his pads. A hint of in-swing on that occasion
back of a length on leg stump. Gill lets the ball come to him before working it past mid wicket for a couple of runs
angled in on a length on off. Gill gets onto the front foot and defends
much fuller, almost a yorker on middle and leg. Gill presses forward and squeezes it out to mid wicket
shot! Marginally short on off and this just sits up to be hit. Gill rocks into position, swivels and belts it through square leg!
safe! Shortish on the hips. Sudharsan gets inside the line and tucks it away uppishly. Lands just short of fine leg, though
up and over! First real sign of aggression from the GT captain! Back of a length just outside off. Gill marches down the track and throws his hands at it, flaying it over cover point!
full again, this time on the pads. Gill gets onto the front foot, snaps his wrists into action and flicks it towards deep square leg for a couple of runs
in-swinging yorker on leg stump. Gill gets forward and digs it out towards mid on
back of a length just outside off. Sudharsan waits for the ball to arrive before running it down to deep third for a single
a little fuller this time, although still a back of a length delivery outside off. A bit of shape away and Sudharsan, pressing forward, taps it into the off side
shortish outside off and Sudharsan is down the track straightaway. Jabs it fiercely towards backward point but cannot beat the fielder

massive lbw shout, and the finger goes up! And Santner has reviewed this as well, just to ensure he remains unbeaten! Zipped in full and this finishes on leg stump. Santner plays all around his flick and gets rapped on the pads. The key question here is where the ball pitched. Could be outside leg. And the ball, in fact, has pitched well outside leg. So Santner, after one of the more pointless reviews in IPL history, will remain unbeaten, but the Gujarat Titans are on the board, and they have done it with room to spare tonight! 4-0 against the Mumbai Indians on this ground, and for the last half hour, that record never seemed under threat!

length ball that slides just down leg. Santner walks across and then misses his flick. The umpire is happy to not call it a wide, but Santner wants a wide, and he has taken it upstairs. Well, on the replay it does look like the ball would have hit Santner had he not moved across his stumps. The third umpire agrees with that assessment after multiple replays and MI lose a review!
shot! Back of a length outside off. Santner stands up tall and then bulldozes it over long on. Almost a flat-batted hit, and that was right out of the middle of the bat!
slower delivery that tests out the middle of the track. Dhir advances and swats it on the bounce to long on
back of a length on middle and off. Skips off the surface and hurries onto Santner. He does not make contact and the ball trickles off his thigh pad into the off side
hard length, angling into off stump. Dhir has a swipe at it and chalks it off the toe-end towards long on

dropped by Prasidh Krishna - his first real misstep tonight! Change-up, into the track on leg stump. Santner gets inside the line and helps it towards short fine leg. Prasidh dives to his right but the ball bursts through his hands. He will feel he should have held on!

another shortish delivery, wide outside off. Dhir tries to fetch it and ramp it over short fine leg but too many moving parts there for the execution to be on-point. Shanked behind square on the leg side
banged in short outside off and this sits up. Dhir also does well to pick the variation and pummels it, beating deep backward square leg to his left!
zipped in full but also well down leg. Left alone by Dhir and called a wide
slower bumper outside off. Dhir has an ungainly swipe across the line and only swats away a few flies in the process
angled in on a length, following the batter outside leg. Santner dabs it towards backward point and has to stay content with a single
Santner goes up and over, and he goes all the way! Back of a length just outside off. Santner creates room for himself, gets his hands through the line and cracks it over mid off!
Dhir ends the over with a boundary! Back of a legth just outside off. Dhir shimmies across early and then scoops it over short fine leg!
change-up again, on a back of a length on off. Santner gives himself room and punches it towards extra cover, who misfields and makes the single a much more comfortable venture
slower ball banged in short on leg stump. Santner tries to get inside the line and hook it away but only manages a deflection off the arm, towards the keeper
shortish on middle and off. Hustled on the pull again and Dhir hacks it towards deep backward square leg
hard length outside off. On-pace and this skids off the surface, rushing Dhir on the pull and eventually beating him because of the extra fizz

Dhir with his first boundary, but surely it is too little, too late now?! Off-pace on a back of a length on off. Dhir shuffles across, uses his wrists and clips it behind square, beating Rabada to his right on the deep backward square leg fence!

soft, soft dismissal and Hardik Pandya has been put out of his misery! Slower ball banged in short outside off. Pandya tries to upper-cut it but there is just no pace to work with. Offers some catching practice to Siraj at short third, and the pacer takes it, despite seemingly losing it in the lights. A 17-ball 11 for the MI skipper, when they needed something much more cavalier, and that perhaps sums up MI's evening!
slower delivery dug into the track outside off. Pandya has a wild mow across the line and jams it off the inside edge into his pads
slower ball on a length on the stumps. Dhir waits for it and works it towards deep mid wicket
slower delivery dug into the track just outside leg. Pandya gets inside the line and helps it towards short fine leg. These singles will not do for MI, though
back of a length on middle and leg. Dhir walks across his stumps and tucks it off his hips towards deep mid wicket
shortish on middle and leg. Pandya opens up his front hip and hacks it towards deep mid wicket

goes a mile up, and snaffled up by Gill at long off! Is that the game as well?! Slower ball on a full length outside off. Suryakumar tries to smoke it downtown but cannot generate the power he is after. Beaten by the lack of pace and he slices it very tamely. Gill judges it to absolute perfection, and this MI chase sinks further into the quicksand!
back of a length on middle and off. Pandya waits for this and stabs it towards deep mid wicket

oh dear - Pandya has gotten stuck at the crease, and cannot buy a run at the moment! Hard length on middle and off. Holds in the surface and that causes a leading edge. Falls short of extra cover, though
back of a length just outside off. Skids off the surface and also keeps appreciably low. Pandya cannot get his bat down in time and that is another dot. Two dots in a row in the 16th over
hard length just outside off. Nips back in, cuts down Pandya's angle and barely gives him any room to work with. Chunks it off the inside edge into his pads
slower ball on a full length outside off. Suryakumar looks to paddle it away but does not get the purchase he is after. Squirts off the inside edge towards short fine leg
back of a length on middle and leg. Suryakumar goes back and knocks it to long on. Keeps strike but just six off that over at a time when MI needed more than 15 per over
back of a length on middle and off. Pandya stays leg side and punches it towards sweeper cover
slightly slower on a length on middle and off. Pandya comes down the track and then defends. Sai Kishore picks up the ball and has a stare-down with the MI captain, who also does not back down
Pandya with a much-needed boundary! Not the greatest ball Sai Kishore will ever bowl either. On a length and well down leg. Pandya tickles it away!
back of a length on middle and leg. No room to work with and Pandya tugs it tamely towards mid wicket
back of a length on middle and leg. Grips in the surface and spins away as Pandya pats it gently towards extra cover
back of a length outside off. Pandya rises with the bounce and jabs it towards sweeper cover. Just four off the over, and GT are beginning to haul this game their way...
dug into the track again, skidding on off stump. Pandya is rushed on the pull and jams it off the inside edge into his body
shortish outside off. Pandya marches down the track and slaps it past extra cover. Sai Kishore makes up ground on the cover fence, slides across to his right and cuts it off
back of a length, slanting into middle and leg. Pandya gets up on his toes and taps it towards mid wicket
slow and short outside off. Suryakumar reaches out for it and edges it down to deep third

oh dear - that will sting! Banged into the track outside off. Suryakumar looks for one of those trademark hooks over short fine leg but gets into an awful tangle this time. Gets a bit of glove and the ball then smashes him on the lid. Suryakumar lies on his back, stunned and staggered by the blow and the physio is out in a jiffy to check on him. Plenty of concern from those on the field too - let's hope he is alright!

and it pays immediate dividends! Minz, sent out to perhaps attack the left-arm spinner, falls to the left-arm spinner! Pushed across the batter on a back of a length outside off. Minz throws the plumbing at it but all he manages is a thick outside edge. Ishant pouches it safely at short third, and Mumbai lose more momentum and another wicket in what is increasingly becoming a tricky chase!
shorter and wider outside off. Suryakumar eases it out to sweeper cover
Suryakumar releases pressure with another sublime shot! Darted in full on middle and off. Suryakumar gets across his stumps early, gets down on one knee and wallops it over deep backward square leg!
back of a length on middle and leg. Minz hops back and pulls it towards short fine leg
back of a length just outside off. Sticks a little in the surface and Minz is content with defending
back of a length just outside off. Suryakumar goes back and knocks it to long on

banged into the track outside off. Minz shapes for the upper-cut but fails to make contact. Called a wide too, on height. GT not very impressed with that call and they have sent it upstairs. Looks touch-and-go, and we might need Ball Tracking to figure this one out. The ball passed the crease at 1.77m, just below Minz's head, measured at 1.79m. Wide overturned!
length angling across the batter outside off. Minz throws his hands at it and slashes it past backward point and towards deep point for a brace
hard length just outside off. Minz gets up on his toes and stabs it towards mid wicket

Prasidh Krishna breaks this partnership! And Tilak Varma, after scratching his way to 39, leaves without that injection of tempo! Off-pace, on a length outside off. Tilak, feeling the pinch of the scoring rate, tries to go downtown but drags it leg-side because of the lack of pace. Arrows it towards long on, where Tewatia runs around to his left and completes a smart grab. Tilak walks off dejected; GT, on the other hand, delighted!
fullish in the channel and that is there to be hit. Tilak, though, tries to smash it into next week and loses all shape. Another fresh-air shot
length on middle and off. Tilak has a huge swing at it, trying to go downtown, and jams it off the inside edge into his back thigh
back of a length, hung up wide outside off again. Tilak goes deep into his crease and guides it towards deep backward point
back of a length wide outside off. Tilak plays at this one and chops it off the under-edge into Buttler's body
length ball fired across the batter well outside off. Left alone by Tilak and called a wide
back of a length on off. Suryakumar waits in his crease and eases it to long on

lovely, lovely shot! Slowed up on a fullish length just outside off. Suryakumar backs away this time and despite being beaten in the air a little, he goes through with the stroke, caressing it over the wide long off fence!
back of a length on off. Skids onto Tilak and he hurriedly stabs it towards deep mid wicket
full just outside off. Suryakumar gets down on one knee and sweeps it towards deep mid wicket
googly on a full length just outside off. Tilak stretches forward and smothers it into the off side. He wanted the single as well but that was never on. Not to Glenn Phillips
slanted in full on the pads. Suryakumar comes forward and works it towards deep mid wicket
dragged down outside off but the lack of pace and bounce off the surface means the batter cannot capitalize. Heaved towards deep mid wicket for a brace
back of a length on leg stump. Tucked away easily towards deep backward square leg
back of a length on middle and off. Stops in the surface a little and Suryakumar chips it towards long on
length on middle and off. Tilak goes back and turns it towards deep mid wicket
scorched across the turf! Very full on off and that was a very risky stroke. Suryakumar went for the sweep and thankfully for him and MI, he smashed it, beating deep backward square leg to his right!
short and wide outside off. Tilak waits in his crease and cuts it towards deep backward point
angled in on a length on middle stump. Suryakumar gets down on the sweep and paddles it towards deep backward square leg
shortish on off. Tilak hops back and pulls it towards deep mid wicket
and Suryakumar sweeps. Of course he does. Full on off and he helps himself to a single to deep backward square leg

back of a length on middle and off. Tilak goes back and places it perfectly between deep backward square leg and deep mid wicket. In trying to stop the second, deep backward square leg over-runs it and ends up conceding the third. Rashid the guilty party
off-pace on a length outside off. Tilak drops it into the off side and saunters across to the other end
full just outside off. Suryakumar gets onto the front foot and pushes it towards mid off
Suryakumar breaks the shackles! Dug into the track on the hips and this is just asking to be hit. Suryakumar gets inside the line and dumps it over the fine leg fence!
fullish outside off. Tilak reaches out for it and laces his cover drive. Cannot get it past extra cover, though, and he has to settle for a single. Good work by Siraj in the ring
back of a length delivery bowled a mile outside off. Tilak lets it go after advancing and then sees the umpire stretch out his arms
that has flown to the fence! A bit of a half-tracker outside off. Tilak spots it early, swivels and pounds it between deep mid wicket and deep square leg!
full and wide outside off. Suryakumar throws his hands at it and gets a thick outside edge that hurtles down to deep third
badgers that short length again, tucking Tilak up on leg stump. He shapes to pull but only manages a deflection off the glove towards the keeper for his troubles
another short ball, although this is seam-up. Tilak is rushed on the pull, takes his eyes off it and heaves it past mid wicket for a couple of runs
slower bumper outside off. Suryakumar sits deep in his crease and drags it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length just ouside off. Tilak waits for the slower one and jabs it into the cover point region
off-pace on a length on off. Suryakumar comes forward and knocks it to long on
full on middle and off. Tilak looks to work to leg and gets a fat leading edge. The ball swirls and drops just in front of Sai Kishore at sweeper cover
googly on a back of a length just outside off. Suryakumar reads it off the pitch (it seems) and defends
back of a length on the stumps. Tilak hangs back and eases it into the on side
fired in on a length down leg. Tilak misses his sweep and the umpire is happy to call it a wide
back of a length on middle and leg. Suryakumar goes back and works it towards mid on
very full outside off. Suryakumar looks for the sweep but sweeps to swish at thin air. Rolls off the pads into the off side
length ball outside leg. Tilak lets the ball arrive before tucking it off his pads towards deep square leg

Rashid traps Tilak in front, and the finger goes up straightaway! But Tilak has reviewed just as promptly! Fizzed through on a length on off. Tilak looks for the reverse first up and gets into a bit of a tangle, perhaps because of the zip off the surface and the speed through the air. Might have struck him just outside off too. Might have kissed the glove as well. In fact, the ball has kissed the glove. There is a spike on UltraEdge when ball is next to glove, and umpire Abhijeet Bengeri's decision has been overturned. Tilak stays!
slower ball dug into the track outside off. Suryakumar cannot get on top of it completely and splices it just beyond square leg. Bags a brace
that is a Suryakumar Yadav special! Wow, that was nonchalant! Length in the fifth stump channel. Suryakumar walks across his stumps and then whips it over the deep backward square leg fence!
dug into the track and this slides down leg with the angle. Suryakumar gets inside the line and then watches it go through to the keeper
hard length on middle and off. Suryakumar gets behind the line of the ball and taps it towards mid on

off stump out of the ground, and Siraj pulls out the Cristiano Ronaldo Siuu celebration! Back of a length, pitching on leg stump and decking away with the angle. Rickelton has a wild whoosh at it and does not cover the line at all. The ball scrapes the inside edge and then sends off stump tumbling. Siraj is over the moon. The Titans fans are overjoyed; the Mumbai Indians, in a spot of bother!

banged into the track on leg stump and this zips through. Rickelton is awfully late on the pull but his blushes are spared by the square leg umpire, who signals for a wide on height. Siraj is surprised at that call
back of a length just outside off. Tilak gets up on his toes and jabs it towards extra cover for a sharpish single
length ball that finishes on leg stump. Rickelton has a swipe at it and misses, getting rapped on the pads in the process. Siraj appeals but that definitely pitched outside leg

off-pace and hung up wide outside off on a back of a length. Tilak nearly swings himself off his feet and still cannot get the purchase he is after. Might have been another inside-edge that dribbled through to Buttler
full just outside off. Tilak shimmies around his crease before eventually stepping outside leg. Swishes hard at it but only grabs a handful of fresh air
length just outside off. Tilak stands up tall and drills it straight to mid off

has Rickelton been run out at the bowler's end?! Slower ball on a full length outside off. Tilak drags it towards the bowler, who gets a hand to it and deflects it onto the stumps. Rickelton, though, shows good awareness to get his left foot behind the line
fullish just outside off. Rickelton gets a good stride in and drives it enough to mid off's right to pick up a single
fuller and much wider outside off. Left alone by Rickelton and the umpire has no qualms in calling it a wide
length ball angling across just outside off. Rickelton has a flat-footed waft at it and gets an inside edge that bobbles through to Buttler
back of a length on middle and leg. Rickelton stands up on his toes and punches it towards mid on
back of a length on middle and leg. This holds in the surface and Rickelton nearly pops it straight to mid on. Rickelton was looking to work that to leg as well
Rickelton is off the mark in trademark style! Back of a length on middle and leg. Perfect for the pick-up pull and Rickelton dumps it over where mid wicket would have been!
length outside off. Rickelton presses half forward and jabs it towards cover point
back of a length just outside off. Keeps a touch low and Rickelton, up on his toes, pokes it back to the bowler
back of a length just outside off. Tilak opens his bat face and runs it down to deep backward point
low full toss outside off. Tilak comes forward and drives it towards mid off. Keeps strike for the start of the third over
the best shot of the lot! This is sumptuous! Zipped in full just outside off. Tilak moves across his stumps early, gets down on the lap and nails it over short fine leg! What courage!
back to back boundaries for Tilak Varma! A little more on the shorter side outside off. Tilak is swinging from the hip and muscles it past mid on!
Tilak with his first boundary! Rabada errs in line and bowls a length ball on the pads. Tilak gets inside the line, gets down low and helps it over short fine leg!
back of a length wide outside off. Tilak has a wild swipe across the line and only connects with fresh air
hard length just outside off. Tilak takes a step down the track and prods it into the off side
back of a length on middle and off. Tilak tips it to mid off and dashes across to the other end to get off the mark
back of a length outside off. Tilak gets up on his toes and pats it gently towards cover point

hot knife through butter! What a comeback by Siraj, and Rohit Sharma has to walk back to the pavilion! This is a proper cracker. Back of a length, pitching just outside off and decking back in sharply. Rohit gets cut in half and gets beaten all ends up. The ball whistles through the gap and then kisses the middle and off bail. A dream delivery, a dream dismissal, and a dream start for the Titans, despite those two boundaries!
four more! On the pads again and this is not the greatest of starts from Siraj. Rohit uses the pace and the angle and glances it fine!
Rohit is up and running! This is angled in, perhaps fuller and definitely more on the pads. Rohit snaps his wrists into action and clips it to mid wicket's right!
full just outside off. Rohit drives at it from his crease and scuffs it towards mid off. Just a hint of away-swing
